headline: Weathered Expanse Reverts to Warden Hands; Berm, Stlican Shelf Flare
war_summary: The lone Colonial post in the Weathered Expanse fell a quarter-hour after the last edition closed, restoring that ruin-strewn region wholly to Warden keeping — seven strongholds, two ruins — after a day's toll past sixteen thousand casualties, though no flag has moved there these two hours. Linn Mercy tells another story: flags have stood since late evening, yet its rolls swell by more than four thousand losses in two hours, the costliest grind in the field. As this edition goes to press, Palantine Berm and the Stlican Shelf flare together, Vendett and Breaker Town the busiest points; the Berm seesaw now stands four Warden posts to three Colonial, the Shelf seven Colonial to two Warden. Stonecradle's tug about The Dais grinds on, eight Colonial posts against one Warden. Nevish Line's flags have held since early evening even as losses mount; Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua has paused, the Gutter is still, and Transient Valley rests under Colonial colors on the Farranac Coast. With thirty-four victory towns the measure of victory, neither side claims the war.
